name: discovery
description: Continuous product-discovery topology — 6 agents (discovery-lead, opportunity-framer, user-researcher, assumption-tester, evidence-auditor, epic-briefer) for translating raw signals into validated opportunities. Pair with board-flow@cepa for board lifecycle, and with build-hex@cepa (or build-team@cepa) for delivery handoff via the engineer-board Epic. Path-lock keyed to docs/discovery/**. The delivery brief carries Validation seeds (how we would know it worked, written BEFORE engineering exists) and Carry-forward notes (implementation-relevant findings discovery hit along the way); both are mandatory with explicit nulls allowed, enforced by common@cepa's handoff-seeds-gate, and both travel verbatim onto the engineer-board card — the build side acts on them rather than consulting them.
